SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_star,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_1star
FROM fdbk_g2 f
JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  AND i.prc_usd <= 40
SELECT rtg, COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body)>500 AND i.prc_usd<=40 GROUP BY rtg ORDER BY rtg
